areas.label: Areas
areas.description: The life areas shown in the Area picker dropdown, in display order.

key.label: Key
key.description: Stable identifier stored on tagged notes as #area, behind the area's position in this list ("01-career"). Moving an area restates that prefix for notes tagged afterwards; run Reapply order in the Maintenance tab to bring existing ones along. Changing a key after notes are tagged orphans their #area label.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this area appears in the picker dropdown and in the Missing Areas triage page.

excludeFilters.label: Exclude Filters
excludeFilters.description: Notes matching any enabled filter's search query are hidden from the Area picker widget and skipped by the Missing Areas triage list.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Trilium search syntax (same as the search bar), e.g. #area or note.type = code.
